title: Software3dAdapter
responsibility: Render a simple projected game scene on a 2D canvas when a WebGL renderer cannot be created.

inputs.name: Software3dAdapter.constructor.canvas
inputs.description: The canvas whose 2D context the constructor takes; render and dispose read its width and height on every call, and render writes dataset.ready and dataset.renderer onto it. The constructor throws when canvas.getContext('2d') returns no context.

inputs.name: Software3dAdapter.render.run
inputs.description: The game run whose state is drawn: state.x and state.y are read with Number() and used as x and z for the player, and only when _view.world is absent do state.hasKey, state.doorOpen and the 'visible:<id>' flags decide which key, door and player boxes are drawn (a flag hides its box only when it is exactly false). Only run.state is read; tick, seed, viewId, progress, completed, events and trace are ignored.

inputs.name: Software3dAdapter.render._view
inputs.description: The scene for this frame: when _view.world is set its LevelLayout is drawn, scaled by min(10 / width, 6 / depth), and when it is absent the built-in fallback scene is drawn. Only _view.world is read, and it is not validated, so id, title, dimension, style, checkpoints, planning and world.spawn do not change the picture.

examples.title: The courtyard
examples.style: Lush illustrated garden, warm stone, soft sunlight. Preserve the player, key and door positions.

checkpoints.title: Collect the key
checkpoints.description: When the player reaches the key, add it to inventory.

examples.title: Stone gallery
examples.style: Quiet stone gallery with cool daylight from high windows.

outputs.name: Software3dAdapter.render
outputs.description: Paints one frame: the whole canvas is filled with #152c29, then the floor and boxes are drawn, and dataset.ready is set to 'true' and dataset.renderer to 'software3d'. When _view.world is set, dataset.dimension is also set to '3d'.

outputs.name: Software3dAdapter.dispose
outputs.description: Clears the whole canvas to transparent pixels; the adapter keeps its canvas and 2D context, so render can draw again, and dataset.ready and dataset.renderer are not reset.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by the constructor with the message 'This browser cannot create a game canvas.' when canvas.getContext('2d') returns no 2D context, so no adapter is created.
